title: I Have Been Blessed With Patience
summary: The shabad does not leave restlessness at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: I have been blessed with patience and composure
lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: By His Mercy, I have met the Holy Saint; i have been blessed with patience and composure
source.lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.
